claims.text: ClickUp offers a free forever plan that supports an unlimited number of users.
ClickUp charges $7 per user per month for its Unlimited plan when billed annually, and $10 per user per month when billed monthly.
ClickUp charges $12 per user per month for its Business plan when billed annually, and $19 per user per month when billed monthly.
ClickUp charges $19 per user per month for its Business Plus plan when billed annually, and $29 per user per month when billed monthly.
ClickUp Enterprise plan pricing is custom and not published online.
ClickUp offers an optional AI add-on called ClickUp Brain for $9 per user per month billed annually.
ClickUp offers a higher-tier AI add-on called Everything AI for $28 per user per month.
ClickUp's paid plans are more affordable than monday work management and Smartsheet, according to a 2026 pricing analysis.
Jira's Standard plan starts at $7.91 per user per month, and its Premium plan is $14.54 per user per month.
Jira offers a free plan for up to 10 users.
Jira Data Center pricing starts at $51,000 per year.
Trello's Standard plan costs $5 per user per month, its Premium plan costs $10 per user per month, and its Enterprise plan costs $17.50 per user per month when billed annually.
Trello's annual billing saves roughly 20% over monthly pricing on Standard and Premium plans.
Backlog by Nulab offers a free plan for up to 10 users.
Backlog by Nulab paid plans start at $35 per month for the Starter plan, with Standard at $100 per month and Premium at $175 per month.
ClickUp includes native time tracking on all plans, including the free plan.
ClickUp's Business plan includes Google single sign-on and required two-factor authentication.
ClickUp's Enterprise plan includes SAML single sign-on, SCIM provisioning, audit logs, session management, and advanced permissions.
ClickUp's Enterprise plan is the only plan that is HIPAA-compliant.
ClickUp's Enterprise plan provides access to a dedicated customer success manager and live onboarding training.
ClickUp's Business plan includes 5,000 automations per month, while the Enterprise plan includes 250,000 automations per month.
ClickUp organizes work into spaces, folders, lists, and tasks, and offers List, Board, Calendar, and Gantt chart views.
ClickUp's free plan includes unlimited tasks, unlimited members, collaborative documents, and 60MB of storage.
ClickUp's Business plan includes unlimited whiteboards, mind mapping, sprint points and reporting, and portfolio workload management.
According to an integration guide, marking hours as billable and using time entry approvals are available only in ClickUp's Business Plus and Enterprise plans.
ClickUp Brain is an AI tool that can analyze trends, automate subtasks, draft replies, generate tables, and convert voice or text into transcriptions.
ClickUp primarily competes with Asana, Monday.com, Notion, Trello, Wrike, and Smartsheet.
Backlog by Nulab is positioned as a top alternative for developer teams.
Trello is pivoting to a personal tasks app aimed at individual users rather than teams, with changes rolling out around April.
Atlassian is discontinuing new Jira Data Center subscriptions on March 30, 2026, with end of life scheduled for March 28, 2029.
Atlassian Server products for Jira reached end of support in February 2024 and no longer receive updates or security patches.
Backlog by Nulab is described as less expensive than Jira, with built-in Git support and bug tracking included in its pricing.
Backlog by Nulab merges task tracking, bug reporting, documentation, and code management via built-in Git and SVN repositories.
Monday.com offers over 200 native integrations, while ClickUp claims more than 1,000 native integrations.
Monday.com's integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, and Jira provide deeper bidirectional syncing than ClickUp's equivalents, according to a 2026 comparison.
One 2026 reviewer ranked ClickUp's free plan above Trello's free tier.
One reviewer found Backlog by Nulab's interface looks dated and its advanced reporting and customization options less flexible than competing tools.
A 2026 reviewer noted that ClickUp offers an extensive library of custom fields that lets users build a mini-database inside projects.
Some G2 users highlight ClickUp's inbox for centralizing notifications from multiple channels and allowing updates to be grouped by date or project.
One analysis identified ClickUp's biggest downsides as a steep learning curve for advanced features such as mind maps and a user interface that can be tricky to navigate.
Teams sometimes look for ClickUp alternatives because the platform can feel overly complex, slows down in larger workspaces, and requires significant setup and training.
Another source notes that ClickUp's advanced tools have a steep learning curve and its mobile apps lack some views available on desktop.
ClickUp's entry-level paid plan at $7 per user per month undercuts Asana's Premium plan at $10.99 per user per month and Asana's Business plan at $24.99 per user per month. (judge: not_stated)
ClickUp's entry-level paid plan at $7 per user per month undercuts Notion's Plus plan at $10 per user per month and Notion's Business plan at $18 per user per month. (judge: not_stated)
Zoho Projects offers paid plans starting at $5 per user per month for Premium. (judge: not_stated)
ClickUp supports native task dependencies, critical path analysis, workload management, milestone tracking, and sprint velocity reporting. (judge: not_stated)
Jira is considered superior for software development and agile tracking. (judge: not_stated)
Trello is viewed as a cost-effective substitute for ClickUp but offers more basic project management features. (judge: not_stated)
Trello lacks native time tracking, while ClickUp includes native time tracking functionality. (judge: not_stated)
A tested review from 2026 concluded that ClickUp provides better overall value than Monday.com for most teams based on pricing and feature density. (judge: not_stated)
ClickUp holds a 4.6 out of 5 rating on G2 based on more than 11,800 reviews. (judge: not_stated)
99% of ClickUp reviewers on G2 rate the product four or five stars. (judge: contradicted)
95% of ClickUp users on G2 say they would recommend the product. (judge: not_stated)
G2 reviewers frequently praise ClickUp for bringing tasks, documentation, dashboards, and team communication into a single workspace. (judge: not_stated)
